AriaSelector.description: AriaSelector matches by ARIA role and accessible name.

name.description: Accessible name, e.g. the button label.

role.description: ARIA role, e.g. button, textbox, link.

SelectorCandidate.description: SelectorCandidate is exactly one of CSS, XPath, Aria or Text.

aria.description: ARIA role and accessible name; the most layout-stable kind.

SelectorEntry.description: SelectorEntry is one named selector in selectors.json: ranked candidates tried in order, plus the plain-words intent for the Jev fallback.

candidates.description: Selectors tried in order; the first that finds the element wins.

intent.description: The element in plain words; used by the AI fallback when no candidate matches.

verifiedAt.description: When the candidates last matched on the live site (RFC 3339).

description: Named selectors referenced by a step's configKey: ranked candidates tried in order.
title: Mono Agent named selectors (selectors.json)
